1.consolidated_definition: Yerba de largas hojas pecioladas, oblongas u ovaladas, con un rizoma de dos a cinco centímetros de largo, el cual produce una fruta pequeña.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial plant with long-stemmed, oblong or oval-shaped leaves and a rhizome of two to five centimeters in length, which produces a small fruit.
